Linux dependency management now presents one primary action that advances from monitoring review to checking committed settings, opening the exact matching revision, and building with LVPM or reviewing a VIPM build. Historical revisions and unsaved choices remain independently protected. Read-only checks preserve edits and compare complete monitoring and worker selections; accepted or uncertain Save requests never imply a merged proposal or allow duplicate submissions. Tooling source repositories and their forks remain excluded from client Reconfigure.

Candidate activation and rollback remain separate reviewed actions in collapsed details. This improves the submission path, not runtime installation or package-pin compatibility: workflow acceptance is not a successful build, and candidate verification is not CI activity validation. Windows behavior is unchanged.
